# Brimwood Innovation

> Build a business. Build yourself.

Brimwood Innovation is a selective innovation hub in Toronto for ambitious
people building AI-powered micro businesses. Membership is by invitation or
referral only. Standard: "Elite by effort, not by background."

## Site

- Home: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/ — what Brimwood is, the four promises, how it works, introduction request form
- About: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/about/ — story, the standard, the hub, weekly rhythm, what we are not
- Blog: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/blog/ — notes on micro business, AI in practice, owner mindset
- Newsletter: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/newsletter/ — signup (double opt-in), email-exclusive archive
- Privacy: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/terms/
- RSS: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/sitemap.xml

## Facts

- Location: 1365 Gerrard St E Unit 2, Toronto, Canada
- Contact: info@brimwoodinnovation.com
- Rhythm: Monday Commit, Wednesday Forge, Friday Show + dine, monthly public demos
- Content pillars: micro business (30%), AI in practice (30%), owner mindset (20%), members + hub (20%)

## Voice

Canadian spelling. Short sentences. No income promises, no hype language,
no "10x" claims. Members are anonymous by default — share the what, never
the how, unless written permission was given.
